snippet.title: Fame or Folly — Official Trailer | Roguelite Deckbuilder
snippet.description:
Fame or Folly is a push-your-luck roguelite deckbuilder where you lead a ragtag troupe of performers from town to town, building absurd combos, managing rising Tension, and chasing the crowd's Approval before everything collapses.

Recruit Troupers. Build broken synergies. Risk it all for one legendary performance.

🎪 Now with multiplayer in development — we're pushing to make Fame or Folly the first developer-supported multiplayer roguelite deckbuilder.

🎮 Wishlist on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4198020/Fame_Or_Folly/

🌐 Official Website
https://fameorfolly.com
